CFO responsibilities for the South Region supporting Consumer, Business Banking and Commercial clients across 5 areas and 455 branches in 4 states with $14 billion in loans and $31 billion in deposits. 

Responsibilities include: proactively identifying value-added financial opportunities, shaping and leading analysis to drive management decisions, ensuring integrity of financial reporting and forecasting.  

Focus on optimizing expenses while maintaining market coverage, increase revenue through balanced growth strategy including reducing interest rate sensitivity and Balance Sheet analytics including pricing analysis around new loan and deposit growth taking into account regulatory impacts.

experience.title: Senior Vice President, Global Compliance Operational Governance Manager
experience.summary:
Developed, implemented and executed operational governance and project standards for Global Compliance project portfolio. Increased accountability and transparency between the line of business compliance executive and project management as well as ensure direct link to the overall strategy.

Managed a project portfolio of 80 projects/$180MM that reduced risk across the enterprise including Reg W, Privacy, AML and other regulatory requirements.

experience.title: Senior Vice President; COO Global Treasury Operations
experience.summary:
Chief Operating Officer of Global Treasury Operations, responsibilities include creating a collaborative environment with business partners and employees across five diverse treasury business units, 20+ products, 3000 employees in 40 locations globally. Deliver service and support through risk management and financial management expertise while keeping focused on the client through performance management. Direct supervisor of 10 employees with indirect supervision of an additional 16 employees. 

Develop operational strategy that links to results through increased transparency in cost and improvements to create competitive advantages. Results included a 7% year over year cost reduction and execution of enterprise cost cutting initiative. Effectively managed financial budget/forecast of $300million.

Created and implemented an end to end risk strategy across GTO that strengthened the overall risk ownership and accountability. Partnered with Global Information Security to prepare our employees for how to respond to cyber attacks. Created a Compliance Risk Database that connected Laws, Rules and Regulations to the GTO business including HIPAA, PCI and OFAC. As a result, we saw a decrease in audit-identified issues and lesser severity. 

Responsible for vendor management across the portfolio to manage and reduce third party risk.

Created an end-to-end people strategy that prepared employees for change, developed mid-level leaders’ management skills, improved talent acquisition and predictive hiring all while connecting employees to Bank of America’s commitments. As a result, employee satisfaction has improved by 3% year over year and a strong bench/pipeline of talent was identified.

Enrich person.name: David Sherrill
Enrich person.title: Senior Vice President--Customer Experience
Enrich person.summary:
Executive leader with 30+ years of experience, including more than two decades dedicated to advancing customer experience. I’m passionate about understanding customer behavior and transforming that insight into strategies that elevate satisfaction, loyalty, and business performance.

Throughout my career, I’ve built a reputation for turning complexity into clarity—translating data, research, and multifaceted challenges into actionable solutions that resonate from the C‑suite to customer-facing teams and support functions.

During my tenure, our Regions team has been honored with multiple industry recognitions, including:

*   Numerous J.D. Power Awards
*   American Customer Satisfaction Index leadership (multiple years)
*   Temkin Group** Top Decile CX performance (multiple years)
*    Javelin Trust in Banking leader (multiple years)
*    Greenwich Excellence Awards in Commercial and Private Wealth (multiple years)
*    Forrester CX Index  leader

Before focusing exclusively on customer experience, I served in key leadership roles across project management, change management, organizational and leadership development, strategic planning, consulting, and enterprise performance improvement. I thrive in the early stages of strategy—where insight, intuition, and collaboration shape the path forward.

In summary: I’m a solutions-driven, customer‑centric problem solver committed to delivering service excellence. My philosophy is simple:  
Every customer. Every experience. Every time. No exceptions.

Enrich person.name: Leah Street Layton
Enrich person.title: Vice President of Commecial Card Client Experience and Implementations
Enrich person.summary:
I'm a commercial banking leader focused on improving the client experience through operational excellence, strategic execution, and strong partnerships across product, sales, service, and technology teams.

Currently serving as Vice President, Commercial Card Client Experience & Implementation Manager at Regions Bank, I lead teams responsible for onboarding, implementing, and supporting commercial card solutions for clients ranging from mid-market businesses to complex enterprise organizations.

My career has spanned both product management and client-facing operations, giving me a unique perspective on how products are built, delivered, and experienced by customers. I believe the best solutions are created when teams align around a common goal: making it easier for clients to do business.

Throughout my career, I've led cross-functional initiatives, managed complex implementations, launched digital banking enhancements, and driven process improvements that increase efficiency while strengthening customer relationships.

I'm passionate about building high-performing teams, simplifying complex processes, and creating scalable solutions that deliver measurable value for both clients and the business.
